headline: SWK Q2 Deep Dive: Productivity Gains and Brand Strength Drive Margin Expansion
summary: Manufacturing company Stanley Black & Decker (NYSE:SWK) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales were flat year on year at $3.96 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.57 per share was 29.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
